title: GenesisSeed
description: Compile-time formation record for a mission archetype. A GenesisSeed defines role, ontology slice, policy defaults, organ affordances, memory rules, and approval gates. Binding a seed to a concrete actor, trust domain, and runtime produces a live twin (Inception). See docs/architecture/enrichment-twin-mission-spec.md for the enrichment_twin archetype example.

seed_id.description: Globally unique seed identifier. Format: seed:<domain>/<name>-<version>

archetype.description: Mission archetype this seed instantiates (e.g. enrichment_twin, analyst_twin, coordinator_twin)

ontology_slice.description: Ontology classes this twin may reason over

goal_schema.description: Schema ref for the goal structure injected at Inception time

organs_allowed.description: Exhaustive list of organ identifiers the twin may invoke

policy_profile.description: Policy refs that govern this twin's actuation

provider_profile.description: Provider refs (model-router, memory-mesh, entity graph, etc.) the twin may call

approval_profile.description: Map of actuation class → approval requirement. Each key names an actuation class; value declares whether approval is required or auto-permitted.
